blocks.text: in / on / at: joy va vaqtdan tashqari

**in**, **on**, **at** ko'chma ma'nolarda ham o'z mantig'ini saqlaydi. **in** — odamni nimadir **o'rab turibdi**: yomg'ir, qorong'ilik, his-tuyg'u, til yoki shakl (**in** the rain, **in** love, **in** English). **on** — odam biror faoliyat yoki vosita **ustida**, unga «ulangan» (**on** holiday, **on** a diet, **on** TV). **at** — o'lchov shkalasidagi **nuqta**: yosh, tezlik, harorat, narx (**at** 18, **at** 100 km an hour). O'zbekchada bu iboralar butunlay boshqacha aytiladi: «yomg'ir **ostida**», «ta'til**da**», «18 **yoshida**», «**ataylab**» — shuning uchun ularni mantiq bilan birga tayyor ibora sifatida ham eslab qolish kerak. Eng oddiylari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 111-dars: on holiday, on TV, at the age of).

rows: **in** the rain, **in** ink, **in** English, **in** a hurry, **in** love

blocks.text: in — sharoit: in the rain, in the dark

Ob-havo va yorug'lik bizni har tomondan **o'rab oladi**, shuning uchun **in**: **in** the rain, **in** the snow, **in** the wind, **in** the fog, **in** the sun, **in** the shade, **in** the dark, **in** the heat, **in** bad weather. O'zbekchada «yomg'ir **ostida**», «quyosh **tagida**» deymiz va inglizchaga «under the rain» deb ko'chirib qo'yamiz — bu xato. Xuddi shunday kiyim ham odamni o'raydi: the woman **in** the red dress (qizil ko'ylakdagi ayol), **in** uniform, **in** her slippers.

items.text: Don't stand **in the rain** — come inside!
It's too hot to sit **in the sun**; let's find a table **in the shade**.
items.translation: **Quyoshda** o'tirish uchun juda issiq; keling, **soyadan** stol topaylik.

items.text: The man **in the grey suit** is our new director.

blocks.text: in — shakl va vosita: in ink, in English, in cash

Biror narsa **qanday shaklda** ifodalanganini aytganda ham **in**: yozuv vositasi — **in** ink, **in** pen, **in** pencil (lekin asbobning o'zi bilan — write **with** a pen); til — **in** English, **in** Uzbek; shakl — **in** capital letters, **in** words / **in** figures, **in** writing (yozma ravishda); ovoz — **in** a whisper, **in** a loud voice; to'lov — **in** cash (naqd pulda; karta bilan — **by** card, → 128-dars). Shuningdek: **in** person (shaxsan), **in** public (omma oldida), **in** my opinion (menimcha).
in — holat: in a hurry, in love, in trouble

His-tuyg'u va vaziyatlar ham odamni «ichiga oladi»: **in a hurry**, **in love** (with), **in a good / bad mood**, **in pain**, **in tears**, **in trouble**, **in danger**, **in debt**, **in shock**. **in charge** (of) — biror narsaga mas'ul. O'zbekchada bularning ko'pi fe'l yoki sifat bilan aytiladi («shoshyapman», «oshiq», «kayfiyati yo'q»), shuning uchun inglizcha **be + in + ot** tuzilishini alohida eslab qoling: I'm **in a hurry** — Shoshib turibman.

items.text: Why is Bekzod **in such a good mood** today?
You'll be **in trouble** if Mum finds out about the broken vase.
items.translation: Agar onam singan guldon haqida bilib qolsa, **baloga qolasan**.

blocks.text: **on** odam biror **faoliyat yoki rejim ustida** ekanini bildiradi: **on** holiday, **on** business, **on** a trip / a tour (→ qizil kitob, 111-dars), **on strike** (ish tashlashda), **on a diet** (parhezda), **on duty** (navbatchilikda; teskarisi — off duty), **on leave** (ta'tilda — rasmiy), **on a course** (kursda). Boshqa muhim iboralar: **on purpose** — ataylab (teskarisi — **by** accident / **by** mistake, → 128-dars), **on the whole** — umuman olganda, **on average** — o'rtacha, **on fire** — yonyapti, **on display** — namoyishda, **on sale** — sotuvda (sotuvga chiqqan; BrE da ko'pincha shunchaki «sotiladi», AmE da «chegirmada»), **for sale** — sotuvga qo'yilgan (uy, mashina).
on — axborot vositalari: on TV, on the news

Efir va aloqa vositalari — **on**: **on** TV, **on** the radio, **on** the news, **on** the phone (telefonda gaplashyapti), **on** the internet, **on** social media, **on** a podcast, **on** a website; so'zlashuvda **online** (predlogsiz). Bosma nashrlar esa — **in**: **in** the newspaper, **in** a magazine, **in** an article (→ 124-dars). Shuning uchun: I saw it **on** the news, but I read about it **in** the paper.

items.text: My uncle was **on the news** after he rescued a child from the river.
items.translation: Amakim daryodan bolani qutqarganidan keyin **yangiliklarda** ko'rsatildi.

items.text: I saw the advert **in a magazine**, not **online**.
Sorry, Dad can't talk now — he's **on the phone** to the bank.
items.translation: Kechirasiz, dadam hozir gaplasha olmaydi — bank bilan **telefonda**.

blocks.text: Son bilan o'lchanadigan narsa — shkaladagi **nuqta**, shuning uchun **at**: yosh — **at the age of** 18 yoki qisqa **at** 18 (18 yoshida); tezlik — **at a speed of** 120 km an hour yoki **at** 120 km an hour, **at full speed**; harorat — **at** 30 degrees, **at a temperature of** ...; narx — **at half price**, **at a price of** ..., **at a discount**; miqdor — **one at a time** (bittadan). Holatni bildiradigan bir nechta ibora ham bor: **at risk** (xavf ostida), **at war** / **at peace** (urushda / tinchlikda).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «under the rain» → **in the rain**; «in TV» → **on TV**; «on the newspaper» → **in the newspaper**; «in purpose» → **on purpose**; «in holiday» → **on holiday**; «I'm in a diet» → **on a diet**; «with a speed of 100» → **at a speed of 100** / **at 100 km an hour**; «in the age of 20» → **at the age of 20**; «pay with cash» → **pay in cash** (karta — **by card**); «write with capital letters» → **in capital letters**; «with English» → **in English**.

Uch savol: 1) Odamni nimadir **o'rab turibdimi** — ob-havo, qorong'ilik, his-tuyg'u, til, kiyim? — **in**. 2) U biror faoliyat, rejim yoki efir **ustidami** — ta'til, parhez, ish tashlash, televizor, telefon? — **on**. 3) Gapda shkaladagi **raqam** bormi — yosh, tezlik, harorat, narx? — **at**.
Bog'lanish: on time / in time — 122-dars; in a book, in the newspaper, on a website — 124-dars; by card, by accident, by mistake — 128-dars; on my own — 83-dars; at / on / in vaqt bilan — 121-dars.

examples.title: **in** the rain, **in** the sun, **in** the dark
examples.description: Ob-havo va yorug'lik sharoiti — in: in the rain, in the sun, in the shade, in the dark, in the heat, in the fog, in bad weather. O'zbekcha «yomg'ir ostida» — in the rain («under the rain» emas).

sentences.text: We walked home **in the rain** because there wasn't a single taxi.
sentences.translation: Birorta ham taksi bo'lmagani uchun uyga **yomg'ir ostida** piyoda qaytdik.

sentences.text: Never leave a dog in a car **in hot weather**, even for five minutes.
sentences.translation: **Issiq havoda** itni mashinada hech qachon qoldirmang, hatto besh daqiqaga ham.

sentences.text: The old men were playing chess **in the shade** of a big plane tree.
sentences.translation: Qariyalar katta chinor **soyasida** shaxmat o'ynashardi.

sentences.text: I couldn't find the light switch, so I had to look for my keys **in the dark**.
sentences.translation: Chiroq tugmasini topa olmadim, shuning uchun kalitlarimni **qorong'ida** qidirishga majbur bo'ldim.

sentences.text: Cyclists should wear bright clothes, especially **in bad weather**.
sentences.translation: Velosipedchilar, ayniqsa **yomon havoda**, yorqin kiyim kiyishi kerak.

sentences.text: Working outside **in this heat** is dangerous, so the builders start at five a.m.
sentences.translation: **Bunday jaziramada** tashqarida ishlash xavfli, shuning uchun quruvchilar ertalab soat beshda ish boshlashadi.

sentences.text: Have you ever driven **in heavy snow**? It's terrifying the first time.
sentences.translation: Hech **qalin qor yog'ayotganda** mashina haydaganmisiz? Birinchi marta juda qo'rqinchli.

sentences.text: Kate's hair was a mess after the long walk **in the wind**.
sentences.translation: **Shamolda** uzoq sayr qilgandan keyin Keytning sochlari to'zg'ib ketgan edi.

sentences.text: The planes couldn't land **in the thick fog**, so we spent the night at the airport.
sentences.translation: Samolyotlar **quyuq tumanda** qo'na olmadi, shuning uchun tunni aeroportda o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: Every summer my grandmother dries apricots **in the sun** on the flat roof.
sentences.translation: Har yozda buvim o'rikni tekis tomda **quyoshda** quritadi.

examples.title: **in** ink, **in** capitals, **in** English, **in** cash
examples.description: Qanday shaklda yoki vosita bilan: in black ink, in pencil, in capital letters, in English, in words / in figures, in writing, in cash, in a whisper, in person.

sentences.text: Please fill in the form **in black ink** and sign it at the bottom.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, anketani **qora siyohda** to'ldiring va pastiga imzo qo'ying.

sentences.text: Write your surname **in capital letters**, exactly as it is in your passport.
sentences.translation: Familiyangizni pasportdagidek **bosh harflar bilan** yozing.

sentences.text: The lecture was **in English**, but the questions afterwards were **in Uzbek**.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza **ingliz tilida** edi, undan keyingi savollar esa **o'zbek tilida** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Some small shops in the bazaar only accept payment **in cash**.
sentences.translation: Bozordagi ba'zi kichik do'konlar to'lovni faqat **naqd pulda** qabul qiladi.

sentences.text: On a cheque you have to write the amount both **in words** and **in figures**.
sentences.translation: Chekda summani ham **so'z bilan**, ham **raqam bilan** yozish kerak.

sentences.text: Could you send me the offer **in writing**? I don't want any misunderstandings.
sentences.translation: Taklifni menga **yozma ravishda** yubora olasizmi? Hech qanday anglashilmovchilik bo'lishini istamayman.

sentences.text: The students spoke **in a whisper** so that the librarian wouldn't hear them.
sentences.translation: Kutubxonachi eshitmasligi uchun talabalar **pichirlab** gaplashishdi.

sentences.text: Draw the plan **in pencil** first — you can always rub it out later.
sentences.translation: Rejani avval **qalamda** chizing — keyin uni doim o'chirib tashlashingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: If you want to renew your passport, you have to apply **in person**.
sentences.translation: Pasportingizni yangilamoqchi bo'lsangiz, arizani **shaxsan o'zingiz** topshirishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Oliver read the poem aloud **in a loud, clear voice**, and everybody clapped.
sentences.translation: Oliver she'rni **baland va aniq ovozda** o'qidi, hamma qarsak chaldi.

examples.title: **in** a hurry, **in** love, **in** trouble: states
examples.description: in + holat — odam go'yo shu holat ichida: in a hurry, in love (with), in a bad mood, in pain, in tears, in trouble, in danger, in debt, in shock, in charge (of).

sentences.text: Sorry, I can't stop — I'm **in a hurry** to catch my train.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, to'xtay olmayman — poyezdga ulgurish uchun **shoshib turibman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has been **in love with** Madina since their first year at university.
sentences.translation: Bekzod universitetning birinchi kursidan beri Madinaga **oshiq**.

sentences.text: Be careful what you say — the boss is **in a terrible mood** today.
sentences.translation: Gapingizga ehtiyot bo'ling — boshliqning bugun **kayfiyati juda yomon**.

sentences.text: The footballer lay on the grass **in pain** until the doctors arrived.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar yetib kelguncha futbolchi maysada **og'riqdan qiynalib** yotdi.

sentences.text: If you don't finish this report by Friday, you'll be **in big trouble**.
sentences.translation: Agar bu hisobotni jumagacha tugatmasangiz, **katta muammoga** qolasiz.

sentences.text: Many animals in the region are **in danger** because their forests are disappearing.
sentences.translation: O'rmonlari yo'qolib borayotgani uchun mintaqadagi ko'plab hayvonlar **xavf ostida**.

sentences.text: Nilufar came out of the exam **in tears**, but she passed in the end.
sentences.translation: Nilufar imtihondan **yig'lab** chiqdi, lekin oxir-oqibat o'tdi.

sentences.text: After buying the flat, the young couple were **in debt** for fifteen years.
sentences.translation: Kvartira sotib olgach, yosh er-xotin o'n besh yil **qarzda** yashadi.

sentences.text: Who's **in charge of** the project while the manager is away?
sentences.translation: Menejer yo'qligida loyihaga kim **mas'ul**?

sentences.text: The driver was **in shock** after the accident and couldn't remember anything.
sentences.translation: Avariyadan keyin haydovchi **shok holatida** edi va hech narsani eslay olmadi.

examples.title: **on** holiday, **on** strike, **on** a diet, **on** duty
examples.description: on + faoliyat yoki vaqtinchalik rejim: on holiday, on strike, on a diet, on duty, on maternity leave, on a training course, on a tour, on business.

sentences.text: Half of my colleagues are **on holiday** in August, so the office is very quiet.
sentences.translation: Avgustda hamkasblarimning yarmi **ta'tilda** bo'ladi, shuning uchun ofis juda jim.

sentences.text: Train drivers are going **on strike** next week, so many services will be cancelled.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta mashinistlar **ish tashlaydi**, shuning uchun ko'plab qatnovlar bekor qilinadi.

sentences.text: No cake for me, thanks — I'm **on a diet** until the wedding.
sentences.translation: Menga tort kerak emas, rahmat — to'ygacha **parhezdaman**.

sentences.text: Which doctor is **on duty** tonight? — Dr Saidova, until eight in the morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun tunda qaysi shifokor **navbatchilikda**? — Doktor Saidova, ertalab soat sakkizgacha.

sentences.text: Emma is **on maternity leave** at the moment, so please contact James instead.
sentences.translation: Emma hozir **dekret ta'tilida**, shuning uchun uning o'rniga Jeymsga murojaat qiling.

sentences.text: Our neighbour's son is **on a gap year** and is travelling round South America.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnimizning o'g'li **o'qishdan bir yillik tanaffusda**, Janubiy Amerika bo'ylab sayohat qilyapti.

sentences.text: We met a lovely family from Oxford when we were **on a boat trip** along the Nile.
sentences.translation: Nil bo'ylab **qayiq sayohatida** bo'lganimizda Oksfordlik ajoyib bir oila bilan tanishdik.

sentences.text: Jasur is **on a training course** in Seoul for six weeks.
sentences.translation: Jasur olti haftaga Seuldagi **o'quv kursida**.

sentences.text: While we were **on a tour** of the Fergana Valley, our guide told us about local crafts.
sentences.translation: Farg'ona vodiysi bo'ylab **sayohatda** bo'lganimizda gidimiz mahalliy hunarmandchilik haqida gapirib berdi.

sentences.text: Are you here **on business** or **on holiday**? — A bit of both, actually.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga **ish bilan** keldingizmi yoki **dam olishga**mi? — Aslida, ikkalasi ham.

examples.title: **on** TV, **on** the news — but **in** the paper
examples.description: Efir va aloqa vositalari — on: on TV, on the radio, on the news, on the phone, on the internet, on social media, on a podcast. Bosma nashrlar — in: in the paper, in a magazine.

sentences.text: Did you see the interview with the president **on TV** last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun **televizorda** prezident bilan suhbatni ko'rdingmi?

sentences.text: There was a report about the floods in Fergana **on the news** this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **yangiliklarda** Farg'onadagi suv toshqini haqida reportaj berildi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I can't hear you — my flatmate is **on the phone** to his girlfriend.
sentences.translation: Kechirasan, eshitmayapman — xonadoshim qiz do'sti bilan **telefonda** gaplashyapti.

sentences.text: I heard my favourite song **on the radio** while I was stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlikda qolib ketganimda **radioda** sevimli qo'shig'imni eshitdim.

sentences.text: Madina posts photos of her cooking **on social media** every day.
sentences.translation: Madina har kuni **ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda** o'zi pishirgan taomlar suratini joylaydi.

sentences.text: You can find almost any recipe **on the internet** these days.
sentences.translation: Hozir **internetda** deyarli har qanday retseptni topish mumkin.

sentences.text: My cousin talked about life in Tashkent **on a popular podcast**.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham **mashhur podkastda** Toshkentdagi hayot haqida gapirib berdi.

sentences.text: I read **in the paper** that the new metro line will open next year.
sentences.translation: **Gazetada** yangi metro liniyasi kelasi yil ochilishini o'qidim.

sentences.text: What's **on Channel 4** tonight? — Nothing much, just a quiz show and the football.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **4-kanalda** nima bor? — Deyarli hech narsa, faqat viktorina va futbol.

sentences.text: There was an interesting article about Khiva **in a travel magazine** I bought at the airport.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda olgan **sayohat jurnalimda** Xiva haqida qiziqarli maqola bor edi.

examples.title: **on purpose**, **on the whole**, **on average**
examples.description: Boshqa on iboralari: on purpose — ataylab (teskarisi — by accident), on the whole — umuman olganda, on average — o'rtacha, on sale — sotuvda (for sale — sotuvga qo'yilgan), on fire, on display.

sentences.text: I'm sure the boy broke the window **on purpose** — he was angry with the neighbours.
sentences.translation: Ishonchim komil, bola derazani **ataylab** sindirdi — u qo'shnilardan jahli chiqqan edi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I didn't do it **on purpose** — the cup just slipped out of my hand.
sentences.translation: Kechir, buni **ataylab** qilmadim — piyola qo'limdan sirg'alib ketdi.

sentences.text: **On the whole**, the conference was a success, although the food was terrible.
sentences.translation: **Umuman olganda**, konferensiya muvaffaqiyatli o'tdi, garchi ovqat dahshatli bo'lsa ham.

sentences.text: **On average**, people in the city spend an hour a day getting to work and back.
sentences.translation: **O'rtacha** shahar aholisi kuniga bir soatni ishga borib-kelishga sarflaydi.

sentences.text: The new smartphone goes **on sale** in Uzbekistan next Friday.
sentences.translation: Yangi smartfon O'zbekistonda kelasi juma **sotuvga chiqadi**.

sentences.text: Their house has been **for sale** for over a year, but nobody wants to buy it.
sentences.translation: Ularning uyi bir yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri **sotuvga qo'yilgan**, lekin hech kim olishni istamaydi.

sentences.text: Firefighters arrived quickly, but half the roof was already **on fire**.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar tez yetib kelishdi, lekin tomning yarmi allaqachon **yonayotgan** edi.

sentences.text: Some of Behzod's miniatures are **on display** at the museum until December.
sentences.translation: Behzod miniatyuralarining bir qismi dekabrgacha muzeyda **namoyish etilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Do you think Tom missed the meeting **on purpose**, or did he really forget?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, Tom yig'ilishga **ataylab** kelmadimi yoki rostdan ham unutdimi?

sentences.text: Women in the country live, **on average**, five years longer than men.
sentences.translation: Mamlakatda ayollar erkaklarga qaraganda **o'rtacha** besh yil ko'proq yashaydi.

examples.title: **at** the age of 19, **at** 140 km/h, **at** half price
examples.description: at — o'lchov shkalasidagi nuqta: yosh (at the age of, at eight), tezlik (at a speed of, at 140 km an hour), harorat (at 30 degrees), narx (at half price), miqdor (one at a time), holat (at risk, at peace).

sentences.text: Jasur started his own business **at the age of nineteen**, with money borrowed from his uncle.
sentences.translation: Jasur amakisidan qarz olgan pulga **o'n to'qqiz yoshida** o'z biznesini boshladi.

sentences.text: The police stopped Tom for driving **at 140 km an hour** on the motorway.
sentences.translation: Politsiya Tomni avtomagistralda **soatiga 140 km tezlikda** haydagani uchun to'xtatdi.

sentences.text: The new high-speed train can travel **at a speed of** 250 kilometres an hour.
sentences.translation: Yangi tezyurar poyezd soatiga 250 kilometr **tezlikda** harakatlana oladi.

sentences.text: Wash this jumper **at 30 degrees**, or it will shrink.
sentences.translation: Bu sviterni **30 darajada** yuving, aks holda kirishib qoladi.

sentences.text: I bought this coat **at half price** in the January sales.
sentences.translation: Bu paltoni yanvar chegirmalarida **yarim narxda** sotib oldim.

sentences.text: Please come in **one at a time** — the room is very small.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **bittadan** kiring — xona juda kichkina.

sentences.text: Children who don't get enough sleep are **at risk** of health problems.
sentences.translation: Yetarlicha uxlamaydigan bolalar sog'liq muammolari **xavfi ostida**.

sentences.text: Mozart wrote his first symphony **at eight**, when most children are learning to read.
sentences.translation: Motsart birinchi simfoniyasini ko'pchilik bolalar o'qishni o'rganadigan yoshda — **sakkiz yoshida** yozgan.

sentences.text: Water boils **at a lower temperature** in the mountains than at sea level.
sentences.translation: Tog'larda suv dengiz sathidagiga qaraganda **pastroq haroratda** qaynaydi.

sentences.text: The two neighbouring countries have been **at peace** for over fifty years.
sentences.translation: Ikki qo'shni mamlakat ellik yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri **tinch-totuv** yashab kelmoqda.

examples.title: Mixed: **in**, **on** or **at**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: sharoit, holat, faoliyat, axborot vositasi va o'lchov — in, on, at iboralari bir misolda.

sentences.text: Aziz proposed to Dilnoza **on a trip** to Khiva, and she said yes **in tears**.
sentences.translation: Aziz Xivaga **sayohat paytida** Dilnozaga turmush qurishni taklif qildi, u esa **ko'z yoshlari bilan** rozi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: We had to change the tyre **in the dark**, **in the pouring rain**.
sentences.translation: G'ildirakni **qorong'ida**, **sharros yomg'ir ostida** almashtirishga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: My grandfather learnt to use a smartphone **at the age of eighty**.
sentences.translation: Bobom smartfondan foydalanishni **sakson yoshida** o'rgandi.

sentences.text: The airline staff are **on strike**, so thousands of passengers are stuck at the airport.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniya xodimlari **ish tashlashgan**, shuning uchun minglab yo'lovchilar aeroportda qolib ketgan.

sentences.text: Is the match **on TV**, or do we have to listen to it **on the radio**?
sentences.translation: O'yin **televizorda** ko'rsatiladimi yoki uni **radioda** eshitishimizga to'g'ri keladimi?

sentences.text: Kate was **in such a hurry** that she left the house **in her slippers**.
sentences.translation: Keyt shunchalik **shoshgan** ediki, uydan **shippakda** chiqib ketibdi.

sentences.text: **In my opinion**, the film was too long, but **on the whole** I enjoyed it.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, film juda uzun edi, lekin **umuman olganda** menga yoqdi.

sentences.text: The lorry was travelling **at full speed** when its brakes failed.
sentences.translation: Yuk mashinasining tormozi ishdan chiqqanda u **to'liq tezlikda** ketayotgan edi.

sentences.text: Did you pay **in cash**, or did you use your card?
sentences.translation: **Naqd pulda** to'ladingmi yoki kartangdan foydalandingmi?

sentences.text: Madina is **on the phone** to her mother, who is **in hospital** in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Madina Buxoroda **kasalxonada yotgan** onasi bilan **telefonda** gaplashyapti.
